Kleine Alley ('ALLEY'/'KLEINE') has two unaligned sections: block 2 (x ~811, Findlay-Poplar, matching Kleine on sheet 203) and block 3 (x ~1900, Poplar-Sherman). Kent Alley ('ALLEY'/'KENT', Findlay-Poplar) and Wolf Alley ('ALLEY'/'WOLF', Poplar south) are collinear across Poplar. Freeman's building lines converge slightly southward (centre x 5717 at Hulbert, 5637 at Liberty). Findlay and Poplar both jog at Freeman, so each has separate east and west T points. Hulbert ends at Freeman (the sheet 215 block is continuous east of Freeman at Hulbert). The block 4 E-W line at y ~5990 is a rear lot line, not an alley. 'PRIVATE' in block 5 is a building label.
